basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech enthusiast from Melbourne, Australia, exploring the world of app development. I have a keen interest in new technologies and how they can be leveraged to improve everyday life. Currently, I'm juggling my final year of university studies in computer science with a part-time job at a local electronics store. In my free time, I enjoy gaming and exploring new subreddits. I usually browse Reddit during the evenings after work or late at night. I'm single and enjoy engaging in discussions about emerging tech trends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a foundational understanding of computer science from my university studies. Over the last few months, I've been diving deeper into app development through online courses and forums. My work at the electronics store also gives me hands-on experience with the latest gadgets and consumer tech.
